synopsis: Star Wars Blueprints: The Ultimate Collection is a reference book released by Dorling Kindersley. It was illustrated by Chris Trevas and Chris Reiff, and was published on August 4, 2008.This incredible collection of blueprint posters shows Star Wars locations like you've never seen them before! Whether it's a breakdown of the hyper drive system in the Millennium Falcon, or the complete floor plan of the Deathstar, these blueprints will impress and amaze any Star Wars fan.
title: Star Wars Blueprints: The Ultimate Collection
